In [[45 ABY]], a '''conflict''' was fought between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the [[Yaka]] regarding their [[Spice/Legends|spice]] operations. The Hutt-Yaka conflict was so intense, that it threatened to erupt into full-blown interstellar combat, and was one of the [[New Jedi Order]]'s many concerns.
